recent_articles.title: Two protests, two responses: Delhi stays calm as Haryana turns water cannons on youth Congress demonstrators - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Youth Congress** and **National Student Union of India (NSUI)** workers staged protests in Delhi and Haryana on Saturday, June 6, 2026, demanding the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** over alleged irregularities in examinations.  In New Delhi, protesters were met with a restrained police response, while in Kurukshetra, water cannons were used to disperse the crowd. **Congress** Lok Sabha MP Deepender Hooda led the demonstration in Haryana, citing high unemployment and drug abuse as reasons for his call for action against the BJP government.

recent_articles.title: In Haryana, suspended Congress MLA’s husband joins BJP, hits out at Hooda | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rishipal**, husband of **Haryana Congress MLA Renu Bala**, joined the **BJP** on Friday, welcomed by **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini**.  **Renu Bala**, who was suspended from the Congress in April for allegedly cross-voting in the Rajya Sabha polls, has been seen attending state government programs alongside BJP leaders. She maintains her membership in the Assembly but could face disqualification if she formally joins another party. **Rishipal** accused senior Congress leader **Bhupinder Singh Hooda** of falsely claiming that his wife had cross-voted and claimed that the Congress prioritizes power over development.

recent_articles.title: Anant Raj shares rally 5% after signing Rs 25,000 crore Haryana Data Centre MoU - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anant Raj**, a real estate and infrastructure developer, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the **Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC)** to invest approximately Rs 25,000 crore in building data centers and cloud infrastructure across Haryana. The agreement was formalized during the "Make in Haryana Policy & Other Sectoral Policies" event on June 1, 2026, and involves several key government departments and agencies. **Anant Raj** aims to expand its Digital Infrastructure Business, which encompasses both data center operations and cloud services.  The partnership is designed to support the company's expansion and position Haryana as a major hub for next-generation digital infrastructure investments.

recent_articles.title: ‘Make in Haryana’ Industrial Policy eyes future-ready industries with AI-driven ecosystem | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** launched the 'Make in Haryana' Industrial Policy, aiming to attract Rs 5 lakh crore in investments and position the state as a powerhouse for future-ready manufacturing. The policy focuses on data centers, GCCs, AI-driven investment facilitation, and emerging technologies. **Rao Narbir Singh**, the Industries and Commerce Minister, emphasized the need for speed and trust in attracting global investors.  **Anant Raj Limited** signed an MoU with the Haryana government to invest ₹20,000 crore in data center infrastructure, while other companies like **Reliance MET City** and **India Cellular and Electronics Association (ICEA)** also pledged investments.

recent_articles.title: ‘Make in Haryana’ Industrial Policy eyes future-ready industries with AI-driven ecosystem | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** launched the ‘Make in Haryana’ Industrial Policy, aiming to attract **Rs 5 lakh crore** in investments and position the state as a hub for future-ready industries. The policy focuses on data centers, global capability centers (GCCs), mega industrial parks, and next-generation technology, with incentives including capital subsidies, R&D support, tax benefits, and sustainability subsidies.  The government also unveiled a revamped “Single Window 2.0” system and a new logo for the state's upcoming Global Investors Summit.  Major companies like **National Australia Bank (NAB)** and **Reliance MET City** have pledged investments in the state.

recent_articles.title: Silent in Question Hour: 14 Haryana MLAs ask fewer than five questions | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Nearly one in ten MLAs in the Haryana Vidhan Sabha have not asked a single question during Question Hour since October 2024, raising concerns about legislative participation. The Indian Express analysis of over 1,075 questions revealed that several legislators were absent from this key accountability mechanism.  While some cited organizational responsibilities and constituency engagements as reasons for lower participation, critics argue that asking questions is a primary responsibility of an MLA. Speaker Harvinder Kalyan emphasized the right of legislators to seek information from the government, while first-time Congress MLA Pooja Chaudhary tops the chart with 56 questions.

recent_articles.title: Haryana government has assured to maintain 1,000 cusecs of water supply through Munak Canal: Delhi CM | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana** Chief Minister Rekha Gupta assured that the state will supply 1,000 cusecs of water to **Delhi** daily through the Munak Canal.  The **Delhi Jal Board (DJB)** is currently producing around 900-924 cusecs of water per day, but faces a shortfall of over 300 MGD during peak summer. The DJB has been working to maintain production and ensure minimal disruption for residents, while also addressing complaints related to water scarcity. **Water Minister Parvesh Sahib Singh** highlighted the challenges posed by the low Yamuna water level at Wazirabad Barrage, but emphasized efforts to sustain water production.  The CM directed officials to address all water leakage complaints and deploy more tankers in affected areas.

recent_articles.title: NDA leaders stake claim to form Assam government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**-led **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was unanimously elected as the leader of the Assam Legislature Party.  Following this, the NDA staked a claim to form the government in Assam with the support of 102 MLAs. The swearing-in ceremony for the new council of ministers is scheduled for May 12th. **J.P. Nadda**, Union Minister and central observer for the BJP Legislature Party meeting, announced that eight BJP legislators proposed Sarma's name as their leader.  The newly elected members of the BJP and its regional allies — **Asom Gana Parishad (AGP)** and **Bodoland People’s Front (BPF)** — chose their leaders in the morning.

recent_articles.title: Punjab worse than West Bengal under AAP rule, says Haryana CM Saini - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** criticized the **AAP government in Punjab**, accusing it of failing to control drug trafficking, illegal mining, and lawlessness. He compared the current situation in Punjab to West Bengal under **Mamata Banerjee**, stating that people are disillusioned with the AAP and seeking change through the BJP's governance model.  Saini also contrasted the BJP's policies with those of the Congress, highlighting the latter's corruption and lack of focus on people's welfare.

recent_articles.title: Saini urges Punjab OBCs to back BJP in Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** urged the OBC community in Punjab to unite and support the **BJP** in the upcoming Assembly elections. He claimed that the party ensures equal representation and criticized the Aam Aadmi Party government's performance, citing disillusionment with poll promises.  Saini highlighted the community's contributions to nation-building and alleged they have been denied opportunities in Punjab. He urged them to support the BJP, referencing measures under Prime Minister Narendra Modi for OBC representation, reservation in education, and constitutional status for the OBC Commission.

recent_articles.title: Haryana Assembly passes women empowerment resolution; Congress boycotts session - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana State Assembly** passed a resolution to form a Special Committee on women empowerment, despite the **Congress party's boycott** of the session.  **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** stated that the committee would support Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision for women empowerment and called out the opposition's "anti-approach" towards women's rights. Former Chief Minister **Bhupinder Singh Hooda**, leader of the **Congress party**, accused the BJP government of making a mockery of constitutional institutions by convening the session on a matter that falls under the jurisdiction of the Central government.

recent_articles.title: Uproar in Haryana Assembly after Congress secures wafer thin win in Rajya Sabha polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: During a heated session of the **Haryana** Assembly, the opposition Congress party accused the ruling **BJP** of suppressing democracy during the Rajya Sabha elections.  The accusations centered on alleged cross-voting and technical disqualification of ballots. The **Congress** MLAs protested, claiming "vote theft" while the **BJP** countered with claims that their candidate was elected fairly. Following a series of disruptions, two candidates were ultimately elected to the Rajya Sabha: **Sanjay Bhatia** (**BJP**) and **Karamvir Boudh** (**Congress**).  The controversy has sparked further debate about the integrity of the election process.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: BJP’s Sanjay Bhatia, Congress’ Karamvir Boudh elected; Haryana CM congratulates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP's** Sanjay Bhatia and **Congress's** Karamvir Singh Boudh were declared elected to two Rajya Sabha seats in Haryana.  Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini accused the Congress of holding its MLAs captive and transferring them, claiming the party is "finished." The INLD abstained from voting, while the Congress filed a complaint against the Returning Officer for alleged partisan conduct. **Congress** candidate Boudh claimed five votes were invalidated, alleging vote theft by BJP MLAs.  Counting began after complaints of vote secrecy violations were lodged.

recent_articles.title: Bhupinder Hooda confident of Congress win in Rajya Sabha polls in Haryana - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
##  Hooda Confident in Congress's Rajya Sabha Victory

Former Haryana Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda expressed confidence in the Congress candidate winning the upcoming Rajya Sabha election on March 16th, despite concerns about cross-voting. He dismissed these worries, stating that all 37 Congress MLAs are united and will vote for their chosen candidate.  Hooda also criticized the BJP government's performance, highlighting issues like rising corruption, unemployment, and a culture of gangsterism in Haryana. He accused Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini of prioritizing Punjab over Haryana, citing his frequent visits to the neighboring state for political events. 

The Congress is facing an uphill battle against the ruling BJP, which holds 48 seats in the 90-member Haryana Assembly.  Hooda's comments come as he seeks to rally support for the party's Rajya Sabha candidate amidst a backdrop of political tension and economic challenges in the state.
